text:
marta: Heads-up — after enabling L7 extra-headers logging on fw-cluster-eu at 03:10, we've spiked outbound audit QPS and hit KMS grant throttles during gpu node onboarding. nodes failed decrypting /etc/keystore on boot.
raj: Ack. I saw autoscaler backoff and a bunch of `Decrypt` errors in the node kubelet logs. Can you paste a snippet?
marta: Sure — from one failing node:
```
Mar 23 03:12:14 kubelet[1234]: error: failed to decrypt: KMS: ThrottlingException: grant limit exceeded
Mar 23 03:12:14 kubelet[1234]: retried 5 times, giving up
```
anika: :warning: That matches the metrics — keystore KMS grant usage jumped 5x when we started sending full L7 bodies + headers to the audit shipper. We didn't plan for that amplification.
sre_lead: Are we seeing this only in eu region? Could be a regional keystore quota plus firewall aggregator pushing logs through privatelink.
marta: Mostly eu1. apac had a small bump but below thresholds. The audit shipper config has two paths: direct S3 ingestion (keystore decrypt per event) and via aggregator (single decrypt then forward). We switched to direct for test and exploded grants.
security_jen: Rolling back the fw change now is allowed? We have the compliance ask for richer logs but getting outage risk is bad. Proposal: revert to headers-only for ~1h, enable sampling, and file a follow-up to implement aggregator path end-to-end.
raj: I can flip sampling and headers-only. Quick command I'm going to run in the firewall console:
```
fwctl set-policy audit_l7_payload=false --region eu1 && fwctl set-sampling 0.1 --region eu1
```
anika: Nice. Meanwhile ops-bot: run the keystore-runbook for nodes failing decrypt so we can mass-retry onboarding.
ops-bot: Running runbook: keystore/repair-onboard. Steps: 1) drain failed nodes 2) restart kubelet with backoff 3) trigger node rejoin. ETA ~15m. Logs will be posted to #eng-sre.
marta: After rollback i saw node decrypt success rates climb from ~60% -> 98% in 9 minutes.
sre_lead: Good. Next actions
- short-term: keep headers-only + sampling for eu1 until daily window passes
- medium-term: route L7 payload audit through aggregator so single keystore decrypt per batch
- long-term: ask platform to request increase on KMS grant QPS for keystore service or implement grant caching (TTL tweak)
security_jen: Also need a compliance note documenting why we sampled for one hour and a timeline of when full logging will be enabled. I'll draft the change request.
raj: Cost note: direct ingestion amplified S3 PUTs and KMS decrypt units — provisional cost ~+12% for the hour in eu1. We'll include in the incident cost report.
anika: Can we add a safety guard to firewall rollouts: if keystore decrypt error rate > 5% then auto-revert to headers-only? Might be worth a quick lambda.
sre_lead: +1 — add an automated watch trigger (metric: keystore/decrypt/error_rate). If >5% for 60s then rollback policy.
marta: I'll open an infra ticket with proposed guard and attach a short test plan. Ticket: INFRA-1289
ops-bot: Incident recorded: incident/1729993333 - "L7-audit -> KMS grant spike causing GPU node onboarding failures". Slack thread will be linked in the incident doc.
security_jen: Thanks everyone. Postmortem owners: anika (root cause + remediation), raj (rollback/runbook), marta (rollout guard + test). I'll schedule a compliance review for next Tuesday.
marta: Closing loop: the immediate rollback + sampling removed the hot-path. No customer-facing impact detected, just onboarding delay. :thumbsup:
